title: Oil Drill Rig MONSTER
tagline: Industrial heavy machinery! Control stepper drilling depth with a rotary click encoder and LCD telemetry.

phases.instructions: Collect the KY-040 Rotary Encoder module, 28BYJ-48 Stepper Motor + ULN2003 driver, 1602 I2C LCD display, and breadboard.
verificationCheckpoints: 28BYJ-48 Stepper with reduction gear shaft ready

phases.instructions: Connect Rotary Encoder CLK to Pin 2 and DT to Pin 3 (hardware interrupt pins). Connect ULN2003 driver to pins 8-11 and LCD to A4/A5.
verificationCheckpoints: Encoder CLK connected specifically to Pin 2 for hardware interrupt support

phases.instructions: Ensure the drill bit shaft has vertical clearance to lower and raise without snagging cables.
verificationCheckpoints: Encoder knob clicks cleanly in both directions

phases.instructions: Examine how hardware interrupts on Pin 2 decode 2-bit Gray code quadrature pulses to determine rotation direction.
phases.codeExplanation:
- attachInterrupt() executes readEncoder immediately whenever CLK falls, with zero missed clicks.
- Checking DT state determines whether rotation was clockwise (drilling down) or counter-clockwise (retracting).
- LCD renders depth telemetry in real time.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand how 90-degree phase shift in quadrature pulses indicates direction
Understand why hardware interrupts prevent missed encoder steps

phases.instructions: Upload code, turn the rotary knob clockwise to lower drill bit, and push the knob down to trigger high-speed auto-retract!
Mission Accomplished! You built an industrial-grade precision positioning mechanism.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Industrial Chief badge

story: Operate heavy industrial robotic drilling equipment! Construct an automated Oil Drill Rig where an incremental rotary encoder with push-button controls stepper drilling depth with precision micrometer readouts on an I2C LCD screen.

troubleshooting.symptom: Encoder skips numbers or increments randomly
troubleshooting.solution: Add small 10nF ceramic capacitors between CLK/DT and GND, or add a 5ms software debounce filter.
diagnosticSteps: Check CLK and DT pull-up resistors or software debouncing.
Verify interrupt service routine has no delay() calls.
